entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Fiji.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de tu fecha de llegada a Fiyi.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Fiji.

entry.en: At Fiji border control you must show an onward or return ticket and a valid visa for the next country you are travelling to.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo de Fiyi debes mostrar un billete de salida o de vuelta y un visado válido para el siguiente país.
entry.quote:
At Fiji border control, you must also show:

- an onward or return ticket

- a valid visa for the next country you’re travelling to

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Fiji, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Customs X-ray all luggage at Nadi airport and will confiscate most fresh foodstuffs, unless you arrive from a country with a quarantine agreement.
entry.es: La aduana escanea todo el equipaje en el aeropuerto de Nadi y confiscará la mayoría de alimentos frescos, salvo que llegues de un país con acuerdo de cuarentena.
entry.quote: Fiji customs has strict quarantine regulations and customs officers X-ray all luggage arriving at Nadi airport. They will confiscate most fresh foodstuffs, unless you’re arriving from a country with quarantine agreements with Fiji.

entry.en: You must declare cash in any currency worth 10,000 Fijian dollars or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar el efectivo, en cualquier moneda, por valor de 10.000 dólares fiyianos o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash in any currency worth 10,000 Fijian dollars or more.

entry.en: Visiting Fiji on business requires a business visitors permit, valid for 21 days.
entry.es: Visitar Fiyi por negocios requiere un permiso de visitante de negocios, válido por 21 días.
entry.quote: If you’re visiting Fiji on business, you must apply for a business visitors permit, which is valid for 21 days.

safety.en: Take additional care walking at night in cities, towns and isolated areas, particularly if you are a woman travelling alone.
safety.es: Ten especial cuidado al caminar de noche en ciudades, pueblos y zonas aisladas, sobre todo si eres mujer y viajas sola.
safety.quote: Take additional care when walking at night in cities, towns and isolated areas, particularly if you are a woman travelling alone.

safety.en: Even small amounts of methanol in alcoholic drinks can kill, and it cannot be detected by taste or smell.
safety.es: Incluso pequeñas cantidades de metanol en bebidas alcohólicas pueden matar y no se detecta por el sabor ni el olor.
safety.quote: Even small amounts of methanol can kill. It is not possible to identify methanol in alcoholic drinks by taste or smell.

safety.en: Many roads are in poor condition and are particularly hazardous at night due to poor lighting, pedestrians and stray animals.
safety.es: Muchas carreteras están en mal estado y son especialmente peligrosas de noche por la falta de alumbrado, peatones y animales sueltos.
safety.quote: Many roads in Fiji are in poor condition and can be dangerous. Roads are particularly hazardous at night due to a lack of street lighting and the chance of pedestrians or stray animals on the road.

safety.en: Tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to April, but cyclones occur throughout the year.
safety.es: La temporada de ciclones tropicales suele ir de noviembre a abril, pero los ciclones ocurren durante todo el año.
safety.quote: Tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to April, but cyclones occur throughout the year.

safety.en: There are dangerous rip tides along reefs and river estuaries.
safety.es: Hay corrientes de resaca peligrosas a lo largo de los arrecifes y las desembocaduras de ríos.
safety.quote: There are dangerous rip tides along reefs and river estuaries.

safety.en: Possession of any amount of marijuana carries a 3-month prison sentence.
safety.es: La posesión de cualquier cantidad de marihuana conlleva una pena de 3 meses de cárcel.
safety.quote: Possession of any amount of marijuana carries a 3-month prison sentence.

health.en: Healthcare facilities are limited, and in serious emergencies people are often evacuated to another country.
health.es: Los centros de salud son limitados y, en emergencias graves, a menudo se evacúa a las personas a otro país.
health.quote: Healthcare facilities are limited in range and availability. In serious medical emergencies, people are often evacuated to another country for treatment.

health.en: Hospitals usually ask for immediate cash payment for health services.
health.es: Los hospitales suelen pedir pago inmediato en efectivo por los servicios de salud.
health.quote: Hospitals usually ask for immediate cash payment for health services.

health.en: Water in Fiji is generally safe to drink, though filtering or boiling is advisable when unsure.
health.es: El agua en Fiyi es generalmente potable, aunque conviene filtrarla o hervirla si hay dudas.
health.quote: water in Fiji is generally safe to drink, though filtering or boiling is advisable when unsure.

health.en: Avoid mosquito-borne illnesses such as dengue by covering up or using repellents outdoors at dawn or dusk.
health.es: Evita enfermedades transmitidas por mosquitos como el dengue cubriéndote o usando repelente al aire libre al amanecer o atardecer.
health.quote: Avoid mosquito-borne illnesses, such as dengue fever and even elephantiasis by covering up thoroughly or using repellents while outdoors at dawn or dusk.

health.en: Fiji can have intense solar radiation that can cause severe skin burns in a short time.
health.es: Fiyi puede tener radiación solar intensa que causa quemaduras graves en poco tiempo.
health.quote: Fiji, like most of the South Pacific, can have intense solar radiation that can cause severe skin-burns in a short amount of time.

health.en: There is only one recompression chamber in Fiji, in Suva, and it is not always working.
health.es: Solo hay una cámara de recompresión en Fiyi, en Suva, y no siempre funciona.
health.quote: There’s only one hyperbaric (recompression) chamber in Fiji, at the Colonial War Memorial Hospital in Suva. It is not always working.

help.en: The emergency number in Fiji is 911 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Fiyi es el 911 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Besides 911, the fire number in Fiji is 910.
help.es: Además del 911, el número de bomberos en Fiyi es el 910.

getting_in.en: Nadi International Airport is Fiji's main international airport, and Suva airport also has some international flights.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Nadi es el principal de Fiyi, y el de Suva también tiene algunos vuelos internacionales.
getting_in.quote: Nadi International Airport (NAN IATA) is Fiji's main international airport, and the main air hub for the Pacific island nations. Suva airport also has some international flights.

getting_in.en: Air New Zealand flies to Nadi from Auckland and Qantas flies from Sydney.
getting_in.es: Air New Zealand vuela a Nadi desde Auckland y Qantas desde Sídney.
getting_in.quote: Air New Zealand operates flights to Nadi from Auckland (AKL IATA), while Qantas operates flights from Sydney (SYD IATA).

getting_in.en: The flight to Fiji takes about 3 hours 40 minutes from Brisbane, 4 hours 30 from Sydney and 5 hours 30 from Melbourne.
getting_in.es: El vuelo a Fiyi dura unas 3 h 40 min desde Brisbane, 4 h 30 desde Sídney y 5 h 30 desde Melbourne.
getting_in.quote: From Brisbane the flight to Fiji is approximately 3 hours and 40 minutes, from Sydney 4 hours and 30 minutes and from Melbourne it is 5 hours and 30 minutes.

getting_in.en: Fiji has five official ports of entry for boats: Savusavu, Levuka, Suva, Lautoka and Oinafa.
getting_in.es: Fiyi tiene cinco puertos oficiales de entrada para embarcaciones: Savusavu, Levuka, Suva, Lautoka y Oinafa.
getting_in.quote: There are five official ports of entry in Fiji: Savusavu on Vanua Levu, Levuka on Ovalau, Suva and Lautoka on Viti Levu, and Oinafa on Rotuma.

getting_in.en: Yachts must not stop at any island until they have clearance from Customs, Immigration, Health and Biohazard officials.
getting_in.es: Los yates no deben detenerse en ninguna isla hasta tener autorización de Aduanas, Inmigración, Sanidad y Bioseguridad.
getting_in.quote: Yachts must not stop at any island until they have clearance from Customs, Immigration, Health, and Biohazard officials.

getting_around.en: Fiji has public transport options including buses, share taxis and private taxis.
getting_around.es: Fiyi ofrece transporte público que incluye autobuses, taxis compartidos y taxis privados.
getting_around.quote: Fiji has a variety of public transport options, including buses, share taxis, and private taxis.

getting_around.en: If a taxi has a meter, ask the driver to switch it on, as the ride will be a lot cheaper than a negotiated price.
getting_around.es: Si el taxi tiene taxímetro, pide al conductor que lo encienda, pues el viaje saldrá mucho más barato que con precio negociado.
getting_around.quote: If the taxi has a meter, ask the driver to switch it on - the ride will be lot cheaper than with the negotiated price.

getting_around.en: Avoid travel at night, especially outside of urban areas.
getting_around.es: Evita viajar de noche, sobre todo fuera de las zonas urbanas.
getting_around.quote: Avoid travel at night, especially outside of urban areas.

getting_around.en: Denarau Marina is the gateway to the Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands, where most cruises and ferries to the western islands operate from.
getting_around.es: Denarau Marina es la puerta de entrada a las islas Mamanuca y Yasawa, de donde salen la mayoría de cruceros y ferris a las islas occidentales.
getting_around.quote: Denarau Marina on Denarau Island is the gateway to all the inhabited Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands. This is where most cruises and ferries serving Fiji's tourism-oriented western islands operate from.

getting_around.en: You must be booked at an island resort for at least 1 night to disembark at islands served by the ferry routes.
getting_around.es: Debes tener reserva en un resort de la isla al menos 1 noche para desembarcar en las islas que sirven las rutas de ferri.
getting_around.quote: It is compulsory to be booked at an island resort for at least 1 night if you wish to disembark at any of the islands serviced by the ferry routes.

getting_around.en: Fiji Searoad runs slow car ferries from eastern Viti Levu to Vanua Levu, Ovalau and Koro.
getting_around.es: Fiji Searoad opera ferris lentos con vehículos desde el este de Viti Levu a Vanua Levu, Ovalau y Koro.
getting_around.quote: Fiji Searoad provides slow (car) ferry routes from eastern Viti Levu to Vanua Levu, Ovalau and Koro.

money.en: The currency is the Fijian dollar (FJD).
money.es: La moneda es el dólar fiyiano (FJD).
money.quote: In Fiji the currency is the Fijian dollar, denoted by the symbol "F$" or "$" (ISO currency code: FJD).

money.en: Tipping is virtually non-existent in Fiji.
money.es: Las propinas prácticamente no existen en Fiyi.
money.quote: In Fiji, tipping is virtually non-existent.

money.en: In tourist regions, expect prices similar to those of Australia.
money.es: En zonas turísticas, espera precios similares a los de Australia.
money.quote: Expect to pay prices similar to those of Australia in tourist regions.

money.en: In some areas the Australian dollar is also accepted, but it is not the preferred method of payment.
money.es: En algunas zonas también se acepta el dólar australiano, pero no es el medio de pago preferido.
money.quote: In some areas, the Australian dollar is also accepted, but unlike some other Pacific Island countries, AUD is not the preferred method of payment.

money.en: Most tourist hotels and many restaurants accept credit cards, but not all ATMs accept the full range of cards.
money.es: La mayoría de hoteles turísticos y muchos restaurantes aceptan tarjeta, pero no todos los cajeros aceptan todos los tipos de tarjeta.
money.quote: Most tourist hotels and many restaurants accept credit cards. Not all ATMs accept the full range of bank or credit cards.

money.en: Small travel counters acting as travel agents may not be accredited or may be an outright scam.
money.es: Los pequeños mostradores que actúan como agencias de viaje pueden no estar acreditados o ser una estafa.
money.quote: Also be aware of small travel counters acting as travel agents, even in some hotels, or on wharves where boats pull in.

etiquette.en: Do not be surprised if shops and other businesses are closed on Sunday.
etiquette.es: No te sorprendas si las tiendas y otros negocios cierran el domingo.
etiquette.quote: Do not be surprised if shops and other businesses are closed on Sunday.

etiquette.en: Dress modestly and keep beach-wear to the beach.
etiquette.es: Viste con modestia y deja la ropa de playa para la playa.
etiquette.quote: Dress modestly and appropriately. While Fiji is a tropical country, beach-wear should be confined to the beach.

etiquette.en: In towns and villages, cover your shoulders and wear shorts or sulus that cover your knees, both genders.
etiquette.es: En pueblos y aldeas, cúbrete los hombros y usa shorts o sulus que cubran las rodillas, ambos géneros.
etiquette.quote: When visiting towns and villages, you should be sure to cover your shoulders and wear shorts or sulus (sarongs) that cover your knees (both genders).

etiquette.en: There is no nudist or topless bathing in Fiji.
etiquette.es: En Fiyi no hay baño nudista ni en topless.
etiquette.quote: There is no nudist/naturist or topless bathing in Fiji.

etiquette.en: If invited to a kava ceremony, be aware of the potential risks of liver toxicity.
etiquette.es: Si te invitan a una ceremonia de kava, ten presente los posibles riesgos de toxicidad hepática.
etiquette.quote: Kava is a traditional drink in Fiji used in kava ceremonies. If you’re invited to take part in a kava-drinking ceremony, be aware of the potential risks of liver toxicity.

connectivity.en: Two mobile companies operate in Fiji, Vodafone and Digicel, plus an MVNO called Inkk that resells Vodafone's network.
connectivity.es: En Fiyi operan dos compañías móviles, Vodafone y Digicel, además de un OMV llamado Inkk que revende la red de Vodafone.
connectivity.quote: There are two mobile phone companies operating on the island (Vodafone, Digicel) as well as an MVNO (Inkk) which resells Vodafone's network.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM chips can be found free or cheap at the mobile operator kiosks in Nadi airport.
connectivity.es: Se pueden conseguir SIM prepago gratis o baratas en los quioscos de los operadores del aeropuerto de Nadi.
connectivity.quote: Tourists are invited to use prepaid sim chips which can be found free or cheap in the mobile operator kiosks in the Nadi airport.

connectivity.en: A locally bought SIM card must be registered.
connectivity.es: Una tarjeta SIM comprada localmente debe registrarse.
connectivity.quote: You can buy a Fiji SIM card at Nadi International Airport and at convenience stores and supermarkets. You must register your SIM card if you buy it locally.

connectivity.en: Phone coverage in rural areas and outlying islands can be limited or non-existent.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil en zonas rurales e islas remotas puede ser limitada o inexistente.
connectivity.quote: Phone coverage in rural areas and outlying islands can be limited or non-existent.

connectivity.en: A SIM chip gives access to cheap data packages, and using your phone as a hot-spot is generally cheaper than resort Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: Una SIM da acceso a paquetes de datos baratos y usar el móvil como punto de acceso suele ser más barato que el wifi del resort.
connectivity.quote: Buying a SIM chip gives access to cheap data packages for easy internet access using your phone as a hot-spot. It is generally cheaper than resort Wi-Fi
